items.title: Miliband says slavery apology will not bring cost for UK taxpayers

items.title: Wall Street edges higher after Democrats sweep midterms

items.title: 'Multi-cancer' blood tests coming to some GP surgeries soon

items.title: Celebrity hairstylist John Frieda dies aged 75

items.title: Police arrest fourth boy after five teenagers stabbed at Halloween party
